editorial.name: Hive Streaming
editorial.descriptionZh: 给大企业内部直播做加速与度量的平台：eCDN 卸掉网络压力，实时看码率和卡顿，事后给出参与度分析。
editorial.takeawayZh: 看企业视频平台怎么按 IT 和传播两条线分别卖
editorial.noteZh: 首屏左边深灰底上写 The Video Experience Platform for Enterprise Live Events，副文案说 Extend your existing enterprise video platform with Hive to increase video quality, see performance in real time, and understand true engagement，配 Talk to a Video Expert 和 How it works 两个入口，右上角只留一个汉堡菜单。往下 Trusted by the Global 2000 to bring clarity, impact, and alignment to every live event.。产品线切得很细：Hive eCDN、Hive Throughput Manager、Hive IT & Network Analytics、Hive Control、Hive Silent Test、Hive Engagement Indicators、Hive Focus，还有 Teams Rooms 支持和 Event Readiness - 1080p 的 1080p 实况测试。角色分流那节直接写成 FOR IT & NETWORK TEAMS 的 The IT playbook 和 FOR LEADERSHIP & INTERNAL COMMS 的 The Comms playbook。

reasons.statement: 这是 Hive Streaming 这家企业视频平台自己的官网，由 saaslandingpage.com 的落地页灵感栏目收进候选池，在本库里作为 B2B 基础设施首页的案例。
导航 Products / Solutions / Customers / Resources 与 /products/ecdn、/hive-streaming-for-it-infrastructure 等内页都是产品说明页，没有可下载的素材或模板，归产品与公司官网。
